name: The ROCKWOOL Foundation
note: Danish non-commercial foundation (CVR 69895328, Ny Kongensgade 6, Copenhagen), established in December 1981 when six members of the Kahler family transferred shares equivalent to 25 percent of ROCKWOOL A/S. It is ROCKWOOL A/S's largest single shareholder: 23 percent of the share capital and 28 percent of the votes, exercised through the General Meetings (rockwool.com, en.rockwoolfonden.dk, checked 2026-10-03). Not a state or state fund.
